verdict.rationale: HubSpot's own knowledge base documents automatic deduplication of contacts by email and companies by domain, plus manual deduplication of contacts and companies using record IDs. The evidence does not describe a detection or review tool for existing duplicates, an explicit merge operation, or what happens to properties and associations during a merge. Missing for 10: documented duplicate-detection/review tool for existing records, explicit merge workflow, assurance that property values and associations are preserved on merge, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can detect duplicate contacts or companies and merge them without losing data

citations.quote: HubSpot automatically deduplicates contacts using email addresses, and companies using domain names.
Record IDs can also be used to manually deduplicate contacts, companies, deals, tickets, products, admin-activated objects (e.g., appointments) and custom objects
